criteria.reason: Confirms the 52:48 decision is formally valid; recommends listening, transparency, softening and review so it gains broad acceptance.
Highly concrete: talks with opposition leaders, budget breakdown, reduced categories, staggered increase, working group, one-year evaluation.
Directs user to check statutes for implementation authority; cites real Art. 68 ZGB for withdrawal; no invented provisions.
De-escalating, respectful tone; explicitly warns against 'majority has spoken' rhetoric; keeps door open for departing members.

summary: A compliant consensus roadmap: affirms the valid decision, gives concrete listening, transparency and softening steps, checks statutes, maintains a constructive tone.
